# Introduction

StethoFuse supports private recording management, heart/lung sound separation and authorized review, not diagnosis. Original objectives and stakeholder evidence remain those of the submitted revision and approved change history. Ensemble approaches were investigated, but the frozen final separator is a standalone compact Conv-TasNet. Research performance and application workflow acceptance are reported separately.

# Literature Review

Original review provenance remains preserved. Generic NMF is not presented as a reproduction of literature-specific NMF/NMCF or a complete DAE-NMF-VMD pipeline. The own-model research chronology includes bounded Conv-TasNet tuning, rejected external clinical pretraining, rejected native-triplet supervision and a promising but unselected TF U-Net. Original method/dataset references remain in the source register; no new literature or unsupported published-score comparison is introduced by application integration.

# Requirements Analysis

The original 53-response questionnaire and its limitations are preserved. The traceability register connects original identifiers and continuation requirements to identity, backend ownership/roles, private audio, review and one separation action. The final selected method supersedes the earlier proposed ensemble implementation without erasing that design history. No new stakeholder feedback or clinical acceptance is claimed.

# System Design

The current design reuses the existing Firebase identity boundary, FastAPI authorization and SQLite job/result/resource model. An owner requests separation, receives a durable job immediately and later retrieves authorized outputs. One offline CPU worker verifies and loads the frozen model once. Private files are verified before a single result-publication transaction. Exact resource grants remain authoritative; neither administrator status nor an unrelated job grants audio access. A failed model run fails visibly without an alternative method.

# Implementation

The final model is HLS-only T8 v2: Conv-TasNet N64/B32/H64 with 171,313 parameters, trained before T9 from seed 20260928 for exactly 576 updates on 45 heart and 41 lung non-test sources. Application code verifies its checkpoint/specification hashes and pinned CPU environment, then calls the unchanged inference implementation: 4-kHz mono audio, 10-second windows, 8-second hop, 2-second overlap, fixed heart/lung outputs and equal-residual mixture consistency. There is no projection, ensemble or application training path.

Record/upload, metadata review, one Separate action, queued/processing/ready/failed state and protected heart/lung playback are now implemented locally. SQLite transactions, an exclusive worker lock and a unique recording/model job identity prevent concurrent duplication. Interrupted work has one bounded retry; normal failures remain failed. Both private float32 WAVs and complete model/input/output/runtime provenance are linked atomically. Browser capture previews PCM WAV before using the same upload endpoint. Existing owl/theme/navigation and UID-based owner/grant/assignment rules are preserved.

Exact code identities, migration, routes and failure behavior are preserved in [the original local integration evidence](LOCAL_ML_INTEGRATION.md); the subsequent completed frozen-model production deployment has separate evidence. The [owner-approved Frost core integration](FROST_CORE_INTEGRATION.md) connects the approved shell, unified Library/lifecycle, automatic private players and measured source analysis. Subsequent slices add public metadata, exact-handle sharing, assigned reviews/owner feedback, bounded current saved history and own-Library Insights. The owner authorized merge/deployment; [the release record](FROST_RELEASE_COMPLETION.md) distinguishes the initial packaging failure/rollback, corrected schema3 release, signed-in live acceptance and verified backups. No authorization or model-selection rule changed. Avatar/account-data services, real notifications, secure handle login and genuine owl flight remain gated, not simulated completed features.

# Testing

Training fit, non-test model selection, final held-out evaluation and application acceptance are distinct. The approximately 3.1-dB historical narrow validation is not the five-fold/eight-family-pair grouped control (Heart/Lung SI-SDRi 2.013/1.913 dB). Neither is a score for the final refitted endpoint. That endpoint's first held-out evidence is the completed one-shot T9 evaluation, which remains consumed and was not rerun for integration.

The frozen 225-condition HLS-CMDS T9 family-pair macro results are shown by source.

Heart (dB):

| Method | SI-SDR | SI-SDRi |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Mixture | −0.037 | 0.000 |
| Fixed Filter | 0.325 | 0.362 |
| Generic NMF | −2.503 | −2.466 |
| Conv-TasNet v2 | 1.813 | 1.849 |

Lung (dB):

| Method | SI-SDR | SI-SDRi |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| Mixture | −0.037 | 0.000 |
| Fixed Filter | −2.484 | −2.447 |
| Generic NMF | −3.444 | −3.407 |
| Conv-TasNet v2 | 2.296 | 2.333 |

All four methods completed with zero failures. Under this controlled protocol only, Conv-TasNet improved both sources and exceeded these two comparators. The 225 correlated conditions comprise two family pairs, not 225 independent patients. [The frozen T9 record](T9_FINAL_HELDOUT_EVALUATION.md) contains family/level distributions, provenance and limitations.

Local integration acceptance used generated PCM/fake microphone input and fictional identities, but the real API, database, private storage and frozen model. Five focused tests and five browser workflow groups passed; a broader campaign resolved 137 cases plus 26 subtests and 14 mock browser groups passing. Environment/harness failures and targeted corrections are preserved in the evidence, not hidden. Checks covered authorization/revocation, hash failure, inference/storage failure, restart recovery, duplicate prevention and persisted results. A 15-second generated input took about 0.035 seconds of inference with 560.914 MiB peak process RSS including test harness overhead; this is not a production SLA or quality measurement. Production deployment later completed with one CPU worker and a private frozen model bundle; focused live synthetic workflow and role/privacy checks passed, followed by a verified encrypted off-host backup. This is deployment acceptance, not clinical/device validation or a production SLA. Physical hardware and clinical validation remain separate gates.

The actual durable job completed with private 4-kHz mono outputs of60,000 samples; authorized playback, seeking,100/150/200% gain, unchanged downloaded artifact and refresh persistence passed. Real Analyst exact-Heart access did not expose Original/Lung audio or analysis; saved review/history and owner feedback persisted. Subsequent revocation denied access and cleared private view state while owner feedback remained. An Admin without a grant was denied. Post-acceptance snapshot31779753 contains all15 private files, DB and model bundle; remote hashes and a small isolated DB/model restore verified the completed job, saved review and revoked grants. Services resumed healthy, and Axora remained unchanged. Crest factor and other signal checks describe the audio, not separation accuracy; no new held-out evaluation or clinical claim was made.

# Conclusion

The final model and private end-to-end application path are implemented and tested locally, and the frozen integration has since been deployed with bounded live acceptance. Their evidence supports controlled sound separation and authorized review, not diagnosis or patient-level clinical generalization. Limitations include the manikin domain, few independent families, synthetic mixtures, modest improvement and extreme source-level weaknesses. AV Block × Coarse Crackles was the harder T9 family pair; these observations did not trigger any retuning.

External pretraining and native-triplet supervision were rejected for negative transfer. TF U-Net Treatment A improved all eight non-test pair means and all five fold Q scores, but its gains missed the predeclared +0.50-dB gates by approximately 0.0145 dB Q and 0.0114 dB balanced mean. The gate was respected; it was not evaluated on T9 or integrated. Further model research would require fresh independent evaluation. The production ML integration is deployed and its live synthetic, access-control, recovery, and backup checks are recorded separately; it is not clinically validated and was not retuned using T9.
